description: Submit SysML declarations to a session, as typing them at the prompt does: the text joins the model, the whole model is re-analyzed, and what it declared and the diagnostics about it come back. Submitting a name again replaces its earlier declaration. For an expression use session_eval; for a % command use repl_command.

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

text.description: SysML v2 (or KerML) declarations, as typed at the prompt; a redeclaration of a name replaces the earlier one

name: session_submit

accepted.description: whether the text was taken into the model without an error of its own

diagnostics.description: the findings about this submission, located in it

file.description: the loaded file the finding is in; empty for text submitted directly

line.description: 1-based line within the file or submission

pass.description: the analysis pass that produced the finding

notices.description: side effects, such as a debugging session the submission ended

text.description: what the prompt printed for the submission
